subject: Sorry, but going to treat you like an Idiot?
author: SUFFUR
body:
Are you sure you have completed all the off-line events, the Burning Routes, found everything?

You can check this through the Start menu, for the PS3, so scan all your discovery page, and if you still have an issue, go to the Criterion Forums, and ask a Guy called ZeroJay to help out, he has a PS3, since I don't.

Oh course, with the PS3 you can download your game save to a STick and then plug it into the Criterion game anyliser, and that might tell you what you are missing.

And if that don't work , ask Criterion. The BurnOUt Team ROCKS!

Also double check those challenges, in case the third person jumped, so challenge failed, and it was not completed.

And no, you're really not an Idiot, unless you did forget to do an event, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
